name: Van Zandt County, TX
findings: Van Zandt County has 122 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Van Zandt County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Van Zandt County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 63% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
